'''2019 MPC Steve Harpster LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Harpster]] at [[2019 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Harpster]]
* '''Event:''' [[2019 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Senate Harpster LS 2019 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
